intro: Tampa's non-climate 10x10 street rate is $117/month, down 3.3% from a year earlier (StorageCafe, September 2026). StorageUnitCosts lists $118 (August 2026). Storage Stats puts the Tampa metro non-climate 10x10 asking rent at $120, down 17.6% from a year earlier (October 28, 2026). The climate-controlled 10x10 figure on the same StorageCafe page is about $135. The advertised rate on this page averages the published figures above. Once the move-in special ends and the first existing-customer increase lands, the six-month average sits above that street rate.
data_asof: Sep 2026 (StorageCafe street rates); Aug 2026 (StorageUnitCosts); Oct 2026 (Storage Stats metro)

units.notes: Locker / closet size. Fixed fees dominate the true cost at this size. StorageCafe street rate $45 (Sep 2026). StorageUnitCosts $46 (Aug 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$49.

Walk-in closet; studio overflow. StorageCafe street rate $67 (Sep 2026). StorageUnitCosts $68 (Aug 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$81. No reliable lowest-promo figure published for this size (gap).

Most rented size. City street rate $117, down 3.3% from a year earlier (StorageCafe industry statistics, Sep 2026). StorageUnitCosts $118, down 4.1% from a year earlier (Aug 2026). Storage Stats Tampa metro non-climate asking rent $120, down 17.6% from a year earlier (updated Oct 28, 2026). That figure covers the metro, not Tampa alone. Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$135.
Two-bedroom contents. StorageCafe street rate $159 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$182.
Three-bedroom home or a car. StorageCafe street rate $196 (Sep 2026). StorageUnitCosts $195 (Aug 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$244.

local_tips: StorageCafe lists Macfarlane Park (~$114), Macdill Airforce Base (~$114), University Square (~$123) among the cheaper areas for a standard unit. Carver City - Lincoln Gardens (~$264) is among the highest.
Tampa has about 114 facilities and 7.1 sq ft of storage per person (StorageCafe).
About 151,851 sq ft of new storage is projected for 2026 (StorageCafe). Ask what month five costs before taking a move-in discount.
Extra Space's published admin fee is $50 on StorageUnitCosts' fee notes, higher than our $29 default; adjust the calculator if your facility charges more.
